in_hebrew.name: Genia
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Source, origin, birth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Genia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Genia represented the goddesses of birth, origins, and beginnings. This name is derived from the Greek word genesis, meaning 'birth' or 'origin'. In Christianity, it is also used as a name for female saints.
